components.css: .ds-sheet{position:relative;background:#fbfcfc;color:#15191b;border-radius:2px;padding:40px;box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0/.14),0 14px 30px -14px rgb(6 26 22/.55)}.ds-sheet::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:10px;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(#15191b,#15191b) top left/14px 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#15191b,#15191b) top left/1px 14px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#15191b,#15191b) bottom right/14px 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#15191b,#15191b) bottom right/1px 14px no-repeat}.ds-sheet h3{font-family:Hahmlet,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:26px;margin:12px 0}.ds-stamp{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px 2px;border:2px solid #d8006b;border-radius:4px;color:#d8006b;font-weight:800;transform:rotate(-6deg)}

narrative.overview: Everything the agency hands over is a 시안, the press proof every Korean shop owner has signed off at a print shop. Work lies as trimmed white sheets on a green self-healing cutting mat: crop marks inside the trim, a CMYK colour bar, a slug line with job details, and magenta proofreading marks where a person would circle something.
keyCharacteristics: Green cutting-mat field with a 24px / 120px ruled grid; plain pale light-table sections between.
Cool white proof sheets with inset crop marks, 2px corners and a real paper shadow; hero and portfolio sheets sit slightly rotated.
Myeongjo display (Hahmlet) set heavy; Pretendard for every control and label.
Process magenta is the only action colour; cyan, yellow and spot orange label the three content types.
One authored motion: a proof prints plate by plate and gets stamped.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Process magenta appears only on things you can press or on proofreading marks. A magenta element that does nothing is a bug.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Content type is always identified by its plate colour (cyan = 블로그, yellow = 상품 설명, spot orange = 광고 카피), as a square chip, never as a tinted card background.

rules.name: The Printed vs Operated Rule
rules.body: If it would be printed on the proof, it is Hahmlet; if you click or read it as interface, it is Pretendard.

rules.name: The Voice-per-Plate Rule
rules.body: Blog drafts read in Myeongjo; product copy uses Pretendard with yellow-highlighted subheads; ad copy uses Pretendard with heavier, spot-underlined subheads.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Only paper casts a shadow. Buttons, chips, inputs and tallies never do.

dos: Do put any new reading content on a proof sheet with crop marks, never directly on the mat.
Do mark content type with its plate chip (cyan, yellow, spot orange) and its label text.
Do keep demo figures and generated drafts labelled as POC/demo content.
Do use tabular figures for order numbers, dates, prices and counts.
donts: Don't use process magenta for decoration, headings or non-interactive fills (The One Ink Rule).
Don't give buttons, chips or inputs shadows (The Paper Rule).
Don't add emoji or glyphs as UI icons; icons are the inline SVG set in index.html (1.9–2.2 stroke).
Don't add a label line above section headings; the heading stands alone.
